_comment: ResQNet disaster simulation scenarios. Each scenario represents a set of spatial / propagation conditions - NOT a claim about a specific real disaster. User placement and initial UAV placement are generated deterministically from a seed (see ml/scenarios.py).

open_area.name: Open Disaster Area
open_area.purpose: Test basic multi-UAV positioning and coverage with users spread widely across a relatively open region.
open_area.note: Reuses the city_damaged mesh. The near-origin operating region of that mesh is relatively open ground with only sparse low structures (see dashboard/assets/scene_meta.json).

dense_urban.name: Dense Urban Disaster
dense_urban.purpose: Test whether UAV positioning adapts to urban obstacles. Users are distributed across different parts of the city.
dense_urban.note: Intact city geometry (city_baseline). Buildings create propagation obstructions.

blocked_urban.name: Blocked / Damaged Urban Area
blocked_urban.purpose: Test UAV repositioning under difficult propagation conditions in the damaged city environment.

clustered_survivors.name: Clustered Survivors
clustered_survivors.purpose: Test whether multiple UAVs learn to distribute themselves across separated survivor clusters instead of unnecessarily clustering together.
clustered_survivors.note: Users grouped into 3 spatially separated clusters.

wide_area.name: Wide-Area Disaster
wide_area.purpose: Test multi-UAV coverage and scalability with users spread over a much larger geographical area.
wide_area.note: Reuses the city_damaged mesh over a larger footprint.
